challenge.method: Challenge terminology and dispatch by comparing a numeric addition, an addition with a non-number, and the first- and second-operand lookup cases in the same section.
challenge.results: The event key stays __add. The non-numeric dispatch path checks the first then second operand as specified. These conditions do not turn the key into the function itself or imply that ordinary numeric addition consults it.

limitations: This supports the event-key name. Dispatch and its failure conditions are separate documented details.
